name: TextBundle Files
changes: Auto import no longer waits 2 seconds or scans again when it refuses a pack.
A read error still gets one retry.
A refused pack that a sync is still writing gets one more try when its size changes.
tip: On desktop, you can drop .textpack files and .textbundle folders on the import window. To send a note to Bear, Ulysses or iA Writer, use Export current note as TextPack.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. TextBundle Files is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
